auksciausia-vistycio-egle: A site of botanical value near Čižiškiai, within the natural landscape of Vištytis Regional Park. It is marked on the map as a separate nature point; when visiting, take care not to damage the growing site.
buvusios-vistycio-cerkves-vieta: Vištytis was a multi-ethnic border town with houses of prayer belonging to several religious communities. The Orthodox church was built in 1912 and burned down in 1944; today a memorial stone marks its location.
buvusios-vistycio-sinagogos-vieta: This point commemorates the Jewish community that lived in Vištytis and its house of prayer. The brick synagogue was built in the middle of the 19th century; only fragments and a memorial stone remain today.
dabravoles-piliakalnis: Dabravolė hillfort dates from the middle of the first millennium to the beginning of the second. Its eastern slope rises about 25 m, an oval plateau sits on top, and traces of an old settlement and pottery have been found at its foot.
dabrovoles-daugiakamiene-liepa: The multi-stemmed lime tree of Dabravolė grows at the foot of the hillfort and has become a landmark of its own. Many trunks branch out from a single base, so the tree complements a visit to the hillfort well.
didysis-vistycio-akmuo: The Great Stone of Vištytis is a boulder of glacial origin; the part above ground measures roughly 7 m long, 5 m wide and 4 m high. In 18th century church records it is called the Stone of the Holy Trinity, and the hollow on its top inspired tales of the Devil's footprint and tears.
kempingas-pusele: A recreation site near Žirgėnai, listed on the map under campsites, holiday cabins and private camping grounds. Before planning an overnight stay, check the season, services and booking arrangements in advance.
kempingas-poilsiaviete-viktorija: A recreation and camping site near Čižiškiai. This is a private property, so current information about the site, its services and staying options should be verified before arriving.
liubiskiu-akmuo: A natural feature marked near Liubiškiai that adds to the boulder-strewn landscape of the Vištytis area. Unverified legends are deliberately left out of this description — what matters here is the boulder itself and its surroundings.
liubiskiu-dvaras: A manor site marked near Liubiškiai and listed under cultural heritage. It is one of the smaller traces of local history, best appreciated together with the surrounding landscape of villages and old homesteads.
mediniu-skulpturu-aleja: The alley of wooden sculptures in the public space of Vištytis combines a walk with local storytelling. The sculptures complement the lakeside route and let visitors discover the town's history through outdoor art as well as buildings.
muziejus-metalo-fantazija: An exhibition space near Žirgėnai devoted to metalwork and its artistic interpretation. Visiting conditions may change, so it is worth confirming opening times before setting out.
paminklas-vistyciui: This monument in the public space of Vištytis is linked to local identity and regional legends. On a walking route it is usually visited together with the historic square, the churches and other landmarks of the town.
paminklas-vytautui-didziajam-vistytis: The monument stands in the setting of the historic square of Vištytis. Together with the established street network, the greenery and the ensemble of churches, it belongs to the urban story of the town.
pavistycio-i-piliakalnis: Pavištytis hillfort dates from the first millennium and lies about a kilometre from Pavištytis village. An oval plateau of roughly 80 × 30 m has survived on top, and the slopes open up views of Vištytis and the small Grabauskas lake.
pavistycio-ii-piliakalnis: The second Pavištytis hillfort dates from the first millennium to the beginning of the second and lies about a kilometre from the first one. It was identified in 2005; the plateau on top measures about 28 × 19 m, and traces of an old settlement were found at its foot.
poilsis-vistytyje: Accommodation near Vištytis, suitable for extending a trip through the regional park by a few days. Information about services, prices and availability is seasonal and should be checked before booking a stay.
raganos-sluota: A distinctive growth formation visible along the Šilelis educational trail, known to visitors as the Witch's Broom. It is one of the natural highlights that make the trail interesting not only for the lakeshore but also for the varied shapes of its trees.
regykla-trys-ezerai: A viewpoint near Pavištytis that opens up a panorama of rolling countryside and lakes. It makes a convenient stop while travelling around the hillforts and the shores of Lake Vištytis.
regykla-vaizdas-i-romintos-giria: A viewpoint on the Šilelis educational trail facing the Rominta Forest that stretches beyond Lake Vištytis. The view works best on the longer route of the trail, where you can watch the hilly relief give way to a solid mass of forest.
sodyba-asterhouse: Accommodation near the town of Vištytis. It can serve as a convenient base for trips to the lake, the hillforts and the educational trails; booking conditions are worth checking before arrival.
strucio-namas: An exhibition site marked near Žirgėnai. It is included on the map as a stop worth visiting, but the timing of a visit and access to the exhibition should be arranged in advance.
suopkalnis: Suopkalnis is one of the hills of the Kylininkai landscape reserve. It opens up wide panoramas of the Pajevonys area, and on a clear day more distant parts of the Vilkaviškis region are visible too. The hill marks the transition from the Sudovian uplands to the gentler, undulating relief of Suvalkija.
sup-savitarna-vistytis: A self-service paddleboard rental point marked near Vištytis. This is a seasonal lakeside service, so before planning a paddle you must check the operating hours, the availability of equipment and the rules for staying safe on the water.
vila-vistytyje: Accommodation in Vištytis, suitable for a trip to the lake and the surrounding sites of the regional park. Availability, prices and check-in conditions may change, so the information is worth verifying before travelling.
vistycio-apzvalgos-vieta: A landscape viewpoint marked near Vištyčio Laukas. Places like this in the park reveal the hilly relief, the lake setting and the sheer scale of this border landscape.
vistycio-evangeliku-liuteronu-baznycia: The church was completed in 1844 and bears witness to the multi-ethnic history of Vištytis. During the Soviet period the building was converted into workshops, and in 1998 it was restored through the efforts and funding of Germans originally from Vištytis.
vistycio-holokausto-auku-memorialas: A memorial dedicated to the victims of the Holocaust in the Vištytis area. It is a place of quiet reflection and historical remembrance, and visitors are asked to behave respectfully.
vistycio-lauko-ii-piliakalnis: The hillfort near Vištyčio Laukas is one of the archaeological landmarks of the region's landscape. It is best visited as part of the wider network of Vištytis hillforts; more precise historical claims are omitted here unless a reliable source confirms them.
vistycio-piliakalnis: Vištytis hillfort dates from the first and second millennia and rises about 20 m above its surroundings. Traces of a cultural layer and pottery have been found on the steep slopes and the plateau. From the top you can see Lake Vištytis, the town and the Vištytgiris forest.
vistycio-poilsiaviete: A public recreation site near the town of Vištytis. It is convenient for a short stop by the lake, but the local rules, facilities and seasonal restrictions are worth checking before arriving.
vistycio-regioninio-parko-lankytoju-cent: The visitor centre presents the hilly landscape of Suvalkija, the natural diversity of the park, its boulders and the history of the town of Vištytis. The exhibition explains where the name Vištytis came from, introduces local symbols and helps you plan a trip through the park.
vistycio-stovyklaviete: A public camping site near Vištytis for travellers who want to spend more time by the lake and in the park. Before settling in, check which facilities are operating in the current season.
vistycio-vejo-malunas: The wooden windmill was built in 1925 on Ilgasis hill by the local craftsman Jonas Kanapkis. The wind turned its sails for about three decades before engines took over the milling. An ethnographic exhibition operated here at the end of the 20th century, and today the mill is protected as industrial heritage.
vistycio-svc-trejybes-baznycia: The present Church of the Holy Trinity in Vištytis was built and altered during the 19th century, between 1829 and 1887. The masonry building stands out for its rare double-cross plan, its classicist features and its tower. A historic bell cast in 1730 has survived inside.
ilankos-poilsiaviete: A public recreation site on Lake Vištytis near Pakalniai. It is a stop for taking in the quiet shoreline and the lake landscape; the available facilities depend on the season and on local maintenance.
silelio-atodanga: The outcrop in the landscape of Šilelis forest is one of the natural stops along the educational trail. On this stretch of the lakeshore, gentle slopes give way in places to steeper rises, so stay on the trail and keep a safe distance from the bluffs.
silelio-mazasis-pazintinis-takas: The circular Šilelis educational trail leads through forest and along the shore of Lake Vištytis. Two routes are officially described: a short one of about 2.4 km and a long one of about 3.4 km. Along the way you can see the Witch's Broom, the outcrop, the Holy Spring and the viewpoint towards the Rominta Forest.
silelio-stovyklaviete: A camping site near Šilelis forest, close to the natural sites of the trail. It can be convenient for those travelling to the lake and along the educational trail, but the rules for staying and the seasonal conditions must be checked.
sventas-vistycio-saltinis: The Holy Spring rises in Šilelis forest, on a small hill by Lake Vištytis. A small hill of crosses has formed beside it, and stories about the healing power of the water have reinforced the sacred character of the place. This is local tradition and belief, not a medical recommendation.
